_readme: Tracks which verticals' situation rooms actually call TSMMemory.registerAnomaly() and therefore show up in RCM OS's Cross-Module Exceptions (Executive tab). 'wired' = confirmed registerAnomaly() call site exists. 'partial' = the page uses TSMMemory (exposure/narrative/timeline) but does not yet register anomalies. 'not_started' = no TSMMemory usage found. Update this file whenever a vertical's adoption status changes so it stays a source of truth instead of tribal knowledge.
sector_key_reference: Sector is auto-detected from the page URL path in tsm-memory-engine.js's detectSector() — codes below must match those keys exactly (construction, healthcare, insurance, finops, legal, tax, bpo, reo, rrd, music, mortgage, schools, executive).

finops.notes: Original 3 rooms from the Cross-Module Exceptions launch (Compliance, Vendor, Logistics), plus working-capital-calculator. finance-index.html registers 5 static anomalies mirroring its own Active Frameworks/Audit Reports/Overdue Invoices figures (SOX flag, overdue invoices, open findings) -- self-dedupes by anomalyCode against the shared store since it has no live-computed snapshot to hook. finops-operations.html registers 5 anomalies mirroring Module 06 Compliance's Policy Validation Errors panel (Whitfield auth-expired, Park missing beneficiary doc, wire-transfer-auth retention gap) and the SLA breach tracker (Whitfield, Park) -- same self-dedupe pattern.

construction.notes: Executive/strategist portals not yet confirmed wired beyond the war room. construction-suite-expansion.html now also registers -- unlike finance-index/finops-operations this page already computes a real live snapshot on every sync (tsmCollectState()/tsmSyncNow(), auto-fires on load, tab switch, and a 90s interval), so registerExpansionAnomalies() hooks into that real data instead of mirroring static content: fires CON_STOCK_CRITICAL when any procurement item is below reorder point, CON_CO_EXPOSURE when total change-order exposure > $0 (severity HIGH at >=$100K), and CON_SCHEDULE_BEHIND when any Gantt task is <50% complete. All three self-dedupe by anomalyCode so the repeated auto-syncs don't pile up duplicates.

bpo.notes: bpo-executive-portal.html and bpo-strategist.html use TSMMemory/TSMExceptions for the P1/P2/P3 exception queue (a separate, older mechanism) — not yet unified with registerAnomaly. Worth reconciling so BPO exceptions surface in RCM OS too, not just its own portal.

healthcare.notes: hc-main-strategist.html runs its OWN separate memory engine (TSM_HC_MEMORY, different API — push()/EVENT_TYPES, not registerAnomaly()). Rather than swap engines (risk of breaking its existing timeline calls), added a registerAnomaly() interop method directly to memory.engine.js that writes into the SAME shared TSM_OPERATIONAL_MEMORY_V3 schema under sector 'healthcare', self-deduping by anomalyCode. hc-main-strategist.html registers 5 static alerts mirroring its own denial-rate ticker/signal panels on load.

insurance.notes: This page did NOT load tsm-memory-engine.js at all before this change (its `if(window.TSMMemory)` guards were silent no-ops) -- added the script include. registerAnomaly() now fires from inside populateFromRelay(), the real relay-parsing function, when parsed data shows compliance posture crit/high, a board item, or approval required -- not a static mirror, since this page has no fixed demo content (everything is '—' until real escalation data arrives).

legal.notes: Same gap as insurance -- tsm-memory-engine.js was never included; added it. registerAnomaly() now fires from loadStrategistRelay() for the top ('SIGN NOW') relayed action whenever real Case Strategist relay data with d.actions arrives.

reo.notes: This page deliberately stubs out TSMMemory (window.TSMMemory={timeline:()=>{},...}) and kills the visual memory-layer widget via #kill-tsm-memory-layer CSS -- that suppression was intentional, so the real engine was NOT loaded here. Instead extended the existing stub with a headless registerAnomaly() that writes directly into the shared TSM_OPERATIONAL_MEMORY_V3 schema under sector 'reo' -- no widget, no visual change, same suppression as before. Registers the 2 static P1 Action Items (TRID Cure Loan #2847, Appraisal Gap 123 Maple St) already shown on the page.

mortgage.notes: Did NOT load tsm-memory-engine.js at all before this change (no TSMMemory usage anywhere in the file) -- added the script include, and added a new 'mortgage' sector branch to tsm-memory-engine.js's detectSector()/DEFAULTS (previously unrecognized, would have fallen through to 'executive'). registerAnomaly() fires from render(), the real relay-parsing function, for the #1 SLA-breaching loan file (same one shown at rank 1 in the Top Risk Register) and a rollup anomaly if any compliance exceptions are open -- not a static mirror, since this page shows 'no active relay' until real Strategist data arrives. Note: this portal's ACKNOWLEDGE/ESCALATE buttons already had a REAL merge-write via recordExecAction() from a prior session (2026-08-02) -- unrelated to this change, left as-is.

schools.notes: Same gap and same fix as mortgage (identical template) -- no TSMMemory usage, added the script include and a new 'schools' sector branch to tsm-memory-engine.js. registerAnomaly() fires from render() for the #1 SLA-breaching grant file and a compliance-exceptions rollup. Unlike mortgage, this portal's ACKNOWLEDGE/ESCALATE buttons are still decorative (toast only, 'no downstream write in this demo build') -- left untouched, out of scope for this pass.

honeywell.notes: Same gap as mortgage/schools -- honeywell-executive-portal.html did NOT load tsm-memory-engine.js at all, added the script include and a new 'honeywell' sector branch to detectSector()/DEFAULTS (path-matches on plant-incident/supplier-shutdown/cyber-incident too, in case those war rooms adopt registerAnomaly directly in a future pass). registerAnomaly() fires from render(), the real relay-parsing function, off the same data.kpis figures the KPI row just rendered: an exposure anomaly per source (CRITICAL for cyber, HIGH for plant, MEDIUM for supplier), a secondary buffer/containment anomaly when that KPI is present, and a supplier-only orders-at-risk anomaly. Not a static mirror -- this page shows 'no escalation received' until a strategist relay actually arrives. Self-dedupes by anomalyCode (keyed to incident source) against the shared store. The plant-incident/supplier-shutdown/cyber-incident war room pages themselves, and honeywell-strategist.html, still do not call registerAnomaly directly -- only the executive portal is wired, matching the mortgage/schools scope (exec portal only, not the source war rooms).

onboarding_checklist: 1. Confirm the page's URL path matches an existing detectSector() branch in tsm-memory-engine.js (or add a new one) so anomalies land under the right sector key.

2. At the point a vertical's own detection logic finds something wrong (a threshold breach, a missing required field, a failed check), call window.TSMMemory.registerAnomaly({ entityType, entityId, anomalyCode, title, severity, source }). anomalyCode should use this vertical's codePrefix (e.g. HC-DENIAL-THRESHOLD) so codes never collide across verticals.

3. Severity must be one of CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW — CRITICAL auto-opens a Mission Core mission from the RCM OS Executive tab, so reserve it for things that actually need someone paged, not just flagged.

4. No new relay domain or mission vertical needed — RCM OS's Cross-Module Exceptions block reads every sector automatically via TSMMemory.getCrossModuleAnomalies(). Once step 2 ships, the vertical shows up there with zero RCM OS-side changes.
5. Update this file's status for the vertical from partial/not_started to wired, and list the actual source file(s).
known_gaps: All of this still lives in browser localStorage (TSM_OPERATIONAL_MEMORY_V3) — per-machine, not server-synced. A fresh browser or different laptop won't see anomalies until it visits the source pages itself. Server-sync is tracked as future work, not done.
No resolution workflow yet: closing the underlying issue in a source room doesn't auto-clear the anomaly in RCM OS's Executive tab.
BPO runs a separate, older exception mechanism (TSMExceptions / bpoFeedExceptions) for its own P1/P2/P3 queue that predates registerAnomaly() and isn't unified with it yet.
